2026-11-13 16:56:29.729497 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-11-13 16:56:29.729503 | controller |
2026-11-13 16:56:29.729514 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-13 16:56:29.729527 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-11-13 16:56:29.729538 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-13 16:56:29.729543 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-13 16:56:29.729553 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-13 16:56:29.729564 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-11-13 16:56:29.729568 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
